mission.title: Unit 7 Checkpoint: Health, Wellbeing and Lifestyle

theory.title: Repaso integrado: rutinas, normas, consejos, condiciones y recuperación
theory.explanation: Este punto de control repasa los contenidos de la Unidad 7 y no introduce gramática nueva. Combina both/either/neither/none, prohibición y falta de necesidad, oraciones temporales, consejos y expectativas, need + -ing, conectores condicionales, acciones pasadas innecesarias, estructuras so/such y pasiva con get.
theory.tip: Distingue obligación, prohibición y falta de necesidad; organiza rutinas con conectores temporales y explica resultados.

content.passage: The wellness centre offers both exercise classes and relaxation sessions. Visitors mustn't use the equipment without guidance, but they don't have to attend every class. You can join the programme as long as you register first. The instructor says you had better rest if you feel unwell. Some machines need to be checked regularly, and the changing rooms need cleaning. One participant got injured last week but got better after a few days of rest.

items.prompt: Compare two activities using both and either.
items.modelAnswer: I think looking after your health is about building realistic habits and making balanced choices. I try to stay active, drink enough water and get regular sleep. When I feel stressed, I take a break or go for a walk. It is important to follow medical advice and ask questions when something is unclear. Small changes can make a big difference over time, especially when people keep practising them.

content.audioTranscript: A: Have you got your appointment tomorrow? B: Yes, I want to talk about my daily routine. A: Are you doing enough exercise? B: I'm trying to. The doctor gave me some useful advice. A: What did they suggest? B: Drinking more water and getting enough sleep. A: Do you need any medicine? B: No, but I need to rest during my recovery. A: I hope you feel better by tomorrow.
